work_identified: Paolo Manuzio (Paulus Manutius, 1512–1574), Epistolarum libri XII — 12 books of his own Ciceronian humanist Latin letters plus prefaces (distinct from his editorial work on Cicero). Note: DB author field reads 'Manuzio, Aldo' but the title page names Paullus Manutius; this is Paolo, son of Aldus, not Aldus himself.
